svg.title: Superscalar RISC-V Datapath
svg.desc: Pipeline from PC through fetch, decode, rename, dispatch, reservation stations, execution, writeback, reorder buffer and commit.
svg.text: ROB positioned at the end; allocation and completion paths remain explicit
